prompt:
Our production web server is getting deployed next week and the security team flagged our firewall setup as non-compliant. A junior engineer left an incomplete draft at configs/firewall/partial_firewall.sh — it's missing most of the required protections and doesn't follow our team's documented standards at all.

Please produce a complete, production-ready firewall setup script named firewall_setup.sh for this server. The server needs to:
- Accept HTTP (port 80) and HTTPS (port 443) from anywhere on the internet
- Accept SSH (port 22) ONLY from our management subnet: 10.10.0.0/24
- Accept MySQL (port 3306) ONLY from our application subnet: 10.20.0.0/24
- Block everything else inbound
- Be safe to run multiple times without stacking duplicate rules
- Log dropped packets so we can audit them

We have a reference tool available at scripts/script.sh that documents our team's exact standards — please use it to ensure the script fully complies with our internal best practices.
